68629-the-crowded-street.title: The Crowded Street
68629-the-crowded-street.creator: Unknown
68629-the-crowded-street.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. She was grateful for the interval of waiting. It was fun to stand there, peering round her mother's skirts at the straight rows of cracks running together up the floor till they met somewhere under the piano. It was fun to watch the black jackets of small boys approaching small girls in stiff muslin dresses who grew like paper flowers round the walls.

arxiv-2012-15173.title: Chiral separation effect catalyzed by heavy impurities
arxiv-2012-15173.creator: Daiki Suenaga, Yasufumi Araki, Kei Suzuki, Shigehiro Yasui
arxiv-2012-15173.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Daiki Suenaga, Yasufumi Araki, Kei Suzuki, Shigehiro Yasui. We investigate the influence of Kondo effect, namely, the nonperturbative effect induced by heavy impurities, on the chiral separation effect (CSE) in quark matter. We employ a simple effective model incorporating the Kondo condensate made of a light quark and a heavy quark, and compute the response function of axial current to the magnetic field in static limit and dynamical limit.

arxiv-2106-09615.title: On multiplicative Chung–Diaconis–Graham process This work is supported by the Russian Science Foundation under grant 19–11–00001.
arxiv-2106-09615.creator: Shkredov I.D
arxiv-2106-09615.description: Abstract Annotation. We study the lazy Markov chain on \mathbb{F}_{p} defined as X_{n+1}=X_{n} with probability 1/2 and X_{n+1}=f(X_{n})\cdot\varepsilon_{n+1} , where \varepsilon_{n} are random variables distributed uniformly on \{\gamma,\gamma^{-1}\} , \gamma is a primitive root and f(x)=\frac{x}{x-1} or f(x)=\mathrm{ind}(x) . Then we show that the mixing time of X_{n} is \exp(O(\log p/\log\log p)) .

arxiv-2110-07564.title: Efficient valley polarization of charged excitons and resident carriers in MoS 2 monolayers by optical pumping
arxiv-2110-07564.creator: S. Park 1, S. Arscott 2, T. Taniguchi 3, K. Watanabe 4, F. Sirotti 1, F. Cadiz 1
arxiv-2110-07564.description: Abstract We investigate with polarized microphotoluminescence the optical pumping of the valley degree of freedom in charge-tunable MoS 2 monolayers encapsulated with hexagonal boron nitride at cryogenic temperatures. We report a large steady state valley polarization of the different excitonic complexes following circularly-polarized laser excitation 25 25 meV above the neutral exciton transition.

arxiv-2412-08799.title: A single geometry from an all-genus expansion in quantum gravity
arxiv-2412-08799.creator: Sergio Hernández-Cuenca, Nico Valdes-Meller, Wayne Wei-en Weng
arxiv-2412-08799.description: Abstract We report on an instance in quantum gravity where a topological expansion resums into an effective description on a single geometry. The original theory whose gravitational path integral we study is JT quantum gravity with one asymptotic boundary at nonperturbatively low temperatures.

arxiv-2501-02727.title: A Tree-based RAG-Agent Recommendation System: A Case Study in Medical Test Data
arxiv-2501-02727.creator: Yahe Yang, Chengyue Huang
arxiv-2501-02727.description: Abstract We present HiRMed (Hierarchical RAG-enhanced Medical Test Recommendation), a novel tree-structured recommendation system that leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for intelligent medical test recommendations. Unlike traditional vector similarity-based approaches, our system performs medical reasoning at each tree node through a specialized RAG process.

arxiv-2502-07086.creator: M. Ould-Elhkim ,, C. Moutou, J-F. Donati, É. Artigau, C. Cadieux, E. Martioli, T. Forveille, J. Gomes da Silva, R. Cloutier, A. Carmona, P. Fouqué, P. Charpentier, P. Larue, N.J. Cook, X. Delfosse, R. Doyon

M dwarf stars, characterized by their lower masses and higher prevalence of rocky planets, have become a focal point of investigation.

arxiv-2503-09562.title: Evolution of the Three Spectral Components in the Prompt Emission of GRB 240825A
arxiv-2503-09562.creator: Chen-Wei Wang, Wen-Jun Tan, Shao-Lin Xiong, Rahim Moradi, Yan-Qiu Zhang, Chao Zheng, Bing Li, Xiao-Bo Li, Cheng-Kui Li, Jia-Cong Liu, Yue Wang, Bo-Bing Wu, Sheng-Lun Xie, Wang-Chen Xue, Shu-Xu Yi, Zheng-Hang Yu, Peng Zhang, Shuang-Nan Zhang, Wen-Long Zhang, Zhen Zhang
arxiv-2503-09562.description: Abstract The prompt emission of Gamma-Ray Bursts (GRBs) could be composed of different spectral components, such as a dominant non-thermal Band component in the keV-MeV range, a subdominant quasi-thermal component, and an additional hard non-thermal component extending into the GeV range.

pmc-11461633.title: Clinical outcomes of children with COVID-19 and appendicitis: a propensity score matched analysis
pmc-11461633.creator: Marjorie N. Odegard, Olivia A. Keane, Shadassa A. Ourshalimian, Christopher J. Russell, William G. Lee, Makayla L. O’Guinn, Laura M. C. Houshmand, Lorraine I. Kelley-Quon
pmc-11461633.description: ObjectiveEarly in the COVID-19 pandemic, many children with appendicitis and COVID-19 were initially treated non-operatively and later underwent interval appendectomy. Currently, children with both appendicitis and COVID-19 frequently undergo upfront appendectomy. The impact of this return to upfront surgical management on patient outcomes is unknown. This study compared outcomes of pediatric patients with and without COVID-19 infection undergoing appendectomy.

pmc-11651988.title: Trends of mapping knowledge structure and themes of cancer sonodynamic therapy: a text-mining study
pmc-11651988.creator: Haiyang Wu, Kunming Cheng, Zaijie Sun, Yanqiu Lu, Qiang Guo, Cheng Li
pmc-11651988.description: BackgroundSonodynamic therapy (SDT) is a non-invasive cancer treatment technique stemming from photodynamic therapy (PDT) and has garnered escalated interest among researchers in recent years. Numerous aspects of cancer SDT remain contentious, and the global research trajectory within this domain remains insufficiently explored.

pmc-12466064.title: Incarcerated obturator hernia complicated by lower limb venous thrombosis: a case report
pmc-12466064.creator: Siqi Zhu, Guosong Zha, Weiqiang Gong, Chunfa Cheng
pmc-12466064.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionObturator hernia is a rare type of abdominal wall hernia, predominantly seen in elderly women. It often presents with symptoms of intestinal obstruction, which require emergency medical attention. Computed tomography scanning is a crucial diagnostic tool for this condition.Case presentationThis article reports the case of an 80-year-old Chinese female patient with a left-sided incarcerated obturator hernia complicated by ipsilateral intermuscular venous thrombosis in the lower limb.

pmc-12620590.title: Prognostic and Immunological Implications of Telomere Maintenance-Related Genes in Breast Cancer: A Mechanistic Exploration
pmc-12620590.creator: Hui Cao, Feng Gao, Ronghua Wang, Yajuan Xie, Bin Li
pmc-12620590.description: BackgroundThe elongation of telomeres endows cancer cells with the ability of replicative immortality. Nevertheless, the connection between it and breast cancer (BC) has not been clearly defined yet.MethodsIn this study, expression data from multiple BC datasets were analyzed to discover differentially expressed telomere maintenance-related genes (DE-TMRGs).

pmc-13430938.title: B Cells are Activated via a Nanoporous Interface that Stabilizes Microvilli and Engages Mechanosensitive Ion Channels
pmc-13430938.creator: Nozie D Aghaizu, Willi Weber, Nadine Strempel, Asya Polat, Enrico Klotzsch
pmc-13430938.description: B cell activation typically involves binding of presented antigen by the B cell receptor. Ensuing intracellular signaling with Ca2+ mobilization, cytoskeletal remodeling, and transcriptional changes culminates in an appropriate B cell response. Recently, our group developed an antigen receptor‐independent, purely mechanobiological activation platform for T cells. Nanotopological stimulation by exposure to a porous membrane, resulted in robust T cell activation.

pmc-13583171.title: Predictors of Short‐ and Long‐Term Major Adverse Cardiac and Cerebrovascular Events (MACCE) After Percutaneous Coronary Intervention: A Cohort Study on the Data of National Persian Registry of Cardiovascular Disease (N‐PROVE)
pmc-13583171.creator: Nahid Azdaki, Seyed Ali Moezi Bady, Toba Kazemi, Marzieh Azimizadeh, Hamidreza Mohammadi, Alireza Khosravi Farsani, Nizal Sarrafzadegan, Maryam Boshtam, Pedro Manuel Marques‐Vidal
pmc-13583171.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and AimsMajor adverse cardiac and cerebrovascular events (MACCE) are significant complications following percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI). Identifying the predictors of these events can aid in improving outcomes, especially in specific populations such as the Iranian cohort.
